No facepalm, sleeve-hug, fists or clasping hands. No drawn sigh symbols. Entire crown, both elbows and ALL lower fingertips comfortably ABOVE the bottom edge; crop the torso below the fingertips around waist/top of skirt. Output 1024x1024.
